_comment: Switch characters from the tray menu (Character) - it hot-swaps with no restart and writes the choice back here. Path is relative to overlay/assets/models/.
_exclude: Expression and motion group names containing any of these are hidden from core, so the LLM is never offered them. Substring match, case-insensitive.
_size: Base window size in pixels. The scroll wheel scales this at runtime; the scaled result is remembered between runs.
_subtitle: Caption styling. position is top|middle|bottom; offsets nudge from there in pixels (y is positive downward); max_chars caps line length so the caption stays near the character. Tray > Subtitle changes these live and writes them back here.
_strip: Where the quick-action buttons sit on the character window: bottom-left, bottom-right, top-left, top-right, or hidden. Panel > Look changes this live.
